caption: The drawing features five elongated metallic hinges, each illustrated in a detailed monochromatic style using shades of gray against a beige background. The hinges have elements such as round or oval plates, rivet or bolt details, and long, tapering arms that end in either a point or a rounded tip. At the left end of each hinge, there is a cylindrical component, suggesting the pivot mechanism. The hinges are arranged in a vertical column, and they vary slightly in their shape and proportions—some with larger central plates, others with smaller or more pointed ends. At the top right corner, there is a small horizontal ruler labeled in inches from 0 to 5. In the upper left corner, handwritten text reads "Rollington Campbell." The drawing is enclosed by a single rectangular border.
title: Strap Hinges
